# GitHub Repository Configuration

This directory contains GitHub-specific configuration and collaboration standards for the AXIVON ONE project.

## Purpose

The `.github` directory is used to maintain:

- Issue templates
- Pull request templates
- Code ownership rules
- GitHub Actions workflows
- Repository collaboration configuration

## AXIVON ONE Development Principle

All contributors should follow the project standards defined in:

`docs/08-GIT-GITHUB-STANDARD.md`

Before contributing to the project, team members should understand the required Git workflow, branch strategy, pull request process, code review process, and repository standards.
